title: 36 Hours in Queenstown, New Zealand
abstract: An adventure town famous for madcap thrills is offering something relatively radical — relaxation.

title: 36 Hours in Hoi An, Vietnam
abstract: Find timeworn architecture, tea ceremonies, modern dining and a world-class circus beneath a bamboo dome on Vietnam’s central coast.

title: 36 Hours in Santa Cruz, Calif.
abstract: Find in microcosm so much that is great about California, including towering redwoods, surf culture and renowned wineries.

title: 36 Hours in Richmond, Va.
abstract: In the onetime Confederate capital, history is being told with newfound clarity.

title: 36 Hours in Barcelona
abstract: Barcelona is not over, as those who branch out to seek Catalonia’s authentic food and often overlooked art will see.
